note: Reviewed warp intrinsics whose mask is not the full warp. A partial mask names a deliberate sub-warp group; a legacy intrinsic needs a HIP or __CUDA_ARCH__ guard. New or unexplained rows fail tools/check_warp_masks.py. Checked 2026-11-24 when the gate was added: 407 intrinsic sites (288 full mask, 58 compat macro, 44 HIP branch, 8 activemask, 2 legacy-guarded, 7 reviewed here).

inkling2_gpu.cu.reason: d_warp8: only lanes 0-7 enter the branch (tid < 8), so the mask names exactly the lanes that reach the shuffle. This is the 0.7.1 fix for the Inkling hang on sm_70+; a full mask would wait for lanes that never arrive.
d_rel_clip: IK_NREL = 16, so only lanes 0-15 enter the branch and the 16-lane mask matches them exactly.

qx_gpu.cu.reason: Flash-Next row_dot: mask = __activemask() taken once before the reduction, and each lane reads its own 8-lane group (base = lane & ~7). Correct while all 8 lanes of a group are active, which is the row_dot call contract (one 8-lane group per row); a partial group would read an inactive lane.
row_dot2, first row: same activemask() 8-lane-group reduction as row_dot.
row_dot2, second row: same activemask() 8-lane-group reduction as row_dot.
